bookingUnitId.title: Booking Unit ID or Name
bookingUnitId.description: Booking Unit record ID or Booking Unit name. Apex resolves its Opportunity__c before fetching payment plan details.

opportunityId.title: Opportunity ID or Name
opportunityId.description: Opportunity record ID or Opportunity name for the booked property whose payment plan should be retrieved.

unitId.title: Unit ID or Name
unitId.description: Unit record ID or Unit name. Apex finds the latest Booking Unit for this Unit and resolves its Opportunity__c.
